studio.description: Per-bar VAH and VAL AOIs built from a nearby market level, exceptional volume, or sign-agnostic four-tick delta within one-third ATR, followed by an ordered sweep, a separate post-sweep big-trade or delta confirmation, an AOI-zone reclaim stop entry, and a fill-time sweep-to-entry structural stop.
studio.label: Yush Orderflow Range Reversal v04

mechanics_review.causal_availability: The latest profile, four-tick delta profile and ATR use completed bars only. Each newly published boundary builds the AOIs visible during the next bar. Large executions must already be causally qualified. Ordered sweep events occur after AOI creation. Confirmation cannot reuse an observation at or before the ordered sweep event. A later same-bar observation may qualify, but the stop-entry order cannot exist until that sweep bar completes. The stop is resolved only on the actual fill event from extrema accumulated from the sweep bar through that event, before sizing or position creation. Targets come from the AOI-time profile.
mechanics_review.entry_logic_rationale: Each AOI applies only to the next three-minute bar and is rebuilt at the following boundary from the then-latest VAH or VAL and confluences. An ordered event at or inside the edge arms the crossing; a later event at the ATR-normalized sweep distance completes a sweep when that bar closes. The completed sweep waits for a distinct later q99.9 large execution or newly accumulated top-decile absolute four-tick delta cell. For a short the confirmation label must be strictly above the frozen AOI-zone bottom; for a long it must be strictly below the frozen AOI-zone top. Only then is the stop-market reclaim entry armed two ticks beyond that boundary. There is no AOI supersession model or intended-stop invalidation before fill, and the confirmed entry order has no clock expiry.
mechanics_review.known_failure_modes: Per-bar AOIs may churn as developing value moves; session-old bursts may be stale; early cross-sectional delta ranks may be unstable; direction-neutral confluence may be unrelated to reversal direction; a market level alone may be too common to identify absorption; a wide AOI zone may reduce fills; the separate confirmation can arrive late or never arrive; a pending order can remain live for a long time; the sweep-to-entry extreme can produce a wide stop; stop-market entry can gap; and requiring two ticks beyond the opposite value-area edge can reduce final-target fills and give back midpoint gains.
mechanics_review.mechanic_expresses_edge: At every completed three-minute boundary, independently attempt a short AOI at the latest VAH and a long AOI at the latest VAL. The AOI exists only when a prior-20-session q99.9 MotiveWave-compatible consecutive aggressive-volume sequence of either side and/or a sign-agnostic top-decile absolute session-anchored four-tick delta cell, or a PDH, PDL, PDC, ONH, ONL, ORH, or ORL lies within one third of causal ATR above or below that edge. A market level may independently qualify the AOI.
mechanics_review.profitability_rationale: The candidate edge is rejection of a developing value edge colocated with exceptional executed volume or absolute delta concentration. Per-bar rebuilding keeps the edge current; the ordered sweep plus a separate post-sweep order-flow observation requires fresh evidence before the reclaim trigger becomes executable.
mechanics_review.session_logic_rationale: Build causally from one RTH profile beginning at 09:30 without a 13:30 reset. Entries remain restricted to 09:39-11:30 and 13:39-15:30 New York, with forced flatten at 15:55. Strategy mechanics have no daily trade cap; account controls remain separate.
mechanics_review.stop_loss_rationale: The order is submitted without a predeclared stop. On the exact causal fill event, after that event has updated the path, resolve the stop two ticks beyond the adverse extreme observed from the entire sweep bar through the entry event, inclusive. Validate the minimum and causal-ATR maximum, size from the resolved risk, and create the position only after the stop is valid.
mechanics_review.target_exit_rationale: When a per-bar AOI is created, retain its value-area midpoint and opposite edge for any setup swept from that AOI. Exit half at the midpoint and the remainder two ticks outside the opposite value-area edge; two ticks below frozen VAL for a short and two ticks above frozen VAH for a long. The one-to-one gross midpoint reward gate is evaluated on the fill event against the resolved sweep-to-entry stop.

mechanics_validation.purpose: Use the repository-wide latest-ten-eligible-session mechanics protocol at frozen defaults. Reconcile the deterministic five-trade sample against MotiveWave Standard value area at Tick Interval 1 plus AOI delta at Tick Interval 4, Range 70 percent and RTH data only. Frequency and performance over longer history belong to later fixed stages and cannot alter this review window. Prior v03 evidence and approval cannot transfer across implementation or research-policy hashes.

studio.timeframe_rationale: Each completed three-minute bar causally republishes the developing profile and ATR, then builds independent VAH and VAL AOIs for the next bar. Ordered events prove the inside-to-outside sweep. A distinct big-trade or newly accumulated delta observation after the sweep event must confirm at the required side of the AOI zone before the reclaim stop order can exist.
